<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1052
Claimant:
Deborah Lynch
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
12/14/2024
Claim received for a collision in a parking lot. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will go
through the attorney's office.
01/05/2025
Spoke with the insured driver, who confirmed the policy is in force and that they were the operator of the vehicle at
the time of the loss. Statement recorded and file opened.
03/10/2025
Police report obtained. It places the claimant in the vehicle at the scene and records the account given by the other
driver, which matches the insured's description of the impact.
03/17/2025
Two independent witnesses gave statements that line up with the reported sequence of events. Scene photos
received and reviewed, and the damage shown is consistent with the described impact.
04/03/2025
Claimant reports a knee injury. The injury is plausible for a collision of this type, and treatment notes have been
requested from the treating provider.
04/13/2025
Medical records received. Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the claimant improved, with no
unusual gaps or escalations noted.
04/15/2025
Prior records show a minor strain in the same area several years ago, which resolved fully without ongiong
complaints. Noted for the file.
04/26/2025
Claimant's counsel supplied a supplemental statement adding a few minor details. The core account remains the
same as the original statement.
07/13/2025
Prior claims database search returned an earlier accident involving the same vehicle, with major damage to the same
area. That incident was neevr reported to us and is now being presented as new damage. Refrered for further review.
07/18/2025
Reviewed the timing against the policy inception and found nothing suggesting the damage predates coverage. The
question for this file is the prior unreported incident, not the policy start.
07/28/2025
Coverage position on hold pending the review of the prior damage and a reconciliation with counsel. Further update
to follow once the review is complete.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
